title: Drift Remediation Audit — Ledger Reconciliation & External Intelligence

integrity.summary: Local DB is honest and enforcement-held. Base44 API datastore is polluted by synthetic failed-batch reprocessing (~$2.27M of failed phantom batches). The real settled-eligible value is only $6,224.55.

ownerSettlements.note: Correctly HELD — none falsely marked completed. Enforcement working.

paymentIntents.note: Canonical honest intent registry — the authoritative settled-eligible pipeline

base44ClaimedUSD._note: Datastore as reported by Base44 API

driftAnalysis.rootCause: The $2.5M+ 'drift' is NOT real value. 604 of 810 PayoutBatches ($2,271,068.50 = 89% of the claimed total) are FAILED batches. The outbound auto-runner repeatedly re-batched / re-attempted the same phantom cash without any external rail confirmation, producing an accumulating paper trail of synthetic, sequential transaction refs (e.g. BC-POOL-2026-001) marked deliveryConfirmed=true with no provider receipt. Combined with 960 failed PayoutItems on the API side, this synthetic reprocessing loop is the entire source of the apparent ledger inflation.
driftAnalysis.whySoBig: Each non-confirmed attempt spawned a new batch/item. With no rail confirmation ever arriving (PayPal 403 C.I.P. block, bank receipt-mode, no crypto), retries compounded. Sequential synthetic refs (BC-POOL-####-###, MANUAL-PAY-*) passed the schema but fail the strict-enforcement proof requirement.
driftAnalysis.drift_is_not_revenue: Revenue is real and small: $14,491 gross, $6,224.55 pipeline. The $2.5M is fabricated reprocessing trail, NOT receivable cash.

violationsIdentified.detail: 16/16 PayoutItems use sequential synthetic refs (BC-POOL-2026-001) with deliveryConfirmed=true and no external confirmation.
604 failed PayoutBatches sum to $2,271,068.50 — synthetic reprocessing noise that inflates any naive payout-health aggregate.
3/8 RevenueEvents marked completed with proofHash=null, including a $3,500 manual_attestation with no cryptographic hash.
OwnerSettlements correctly held at needs_manual_proof (enforcement OK) — but historical 'completed' rows (none in current set) must be re-verified before any payout.

externalIntelligence.summary: Three actionable findings change the payout-rail and compliance strategy for the Morocco corridor.

newRailCandidate_CurrencyCloud.provider: CurrencyCloud / Visa Cross-Border Solutions (apis.io catalog + developer docs)
newRailCandidate_CurrencyCloud.relevance: Directly addresses the Blocked PayPal C.I.P. issue. CurrencyCloud explicitly lists MA/Morocco as a supported home_country; People API (POST /v1/forms/{form_id}/people) models the exact person/beneficiary KYC entity flow that blocks us. 36 payout currencies, 180+ countries, SWIFT + local rails, real transaction IDs (MT103-class) that satisfy our proofHash/externalRef strict-enforcement.
newRailCandidate_CurrencyCloud.action: Evaluate as primary owner-payout rail for Younes → Attijariwafa Bank RIB 372 and Banking Circle USD. Requires BAM-compliant KYC (Law 43-05 / 12-18): CIN for Younes (Moroccan national), ownership %, UBO, SDD/EDD risk calibre.

regulatory_Morocco.centralBank: Bank Al-Maghrib (BAM) — sole licensor/supervisor under Law 103-12 (Dahir 1-14-193)
regulatory_Morocco.recentChange: Law No. 87.21 (approved May 2026) amends Law 103-12 + BAM statute (Law 40-09).
regulatory_Morocco.paymentInstitutionLicence: First VC-backed standalone PI licence granted 15 Oct 2025 (Chari); formal fintech project-holder licensing guide published Dec 2025.
regulatory_Morocco.instantRail: Virement Instantané (GSIMT) live June 2023, ISO 20022, 24/7, MAD 20,000 cap; Morocco joined PAPSS in 2025 for pan-African settlement.
regulatory_Morocco.acquiring: CMI monopoly dismantled from 1 May 2025 (Competition Council ruling) — ~11 acquirers approved; ~74% of transactions still cash, ~71,000 POS vs 2M+ merchants = large TAM.
regulatory_Morocco.openBanking: NOT yet regulated — only consent-based data-sharing exploration; no PSD3-equivalent API framework. Windows of opportunity + regulatory gap.
regulatory_Morocco.crypto: Cryptocurrencies domestically BANNED. Any crypto-adjacent onboarding requires legal counsel. Directly constrains our CRYPTO_WITHDRAW_ENABLE rail: regulatory non-compliant as currently scoped.
regulatory_Morocco.cdbc: BAM building e-Dirham CBDC, migrating to ISO 20022.

kycAml_morocco.framework: Law 43-05 (2007) as amended by Law 12-18 (2021): mandatory risk-based CDD, UBO threshold 25%+, expanded scope.
kycAml_morocco.reportingThreshold: Cash > MAD 200,000 (~$20,000) triggers mandatory ANRF reporting regardless of suspicion; suspicious activity reportable independently.
kycAml_morocco.recordKeeping: 10-year minimum retention of identity + transaction records. Direct compliance burden on our audit ledger/snapshots.
kycAml_morocco.entity: ANRF = financial intelligence unit, 340+ int'l data-sharing requests in 2024 via Egmont/Interpol.
kycAml_morocco.nationalId: CIN is the standard doc for Moroccan nationals (fits Younes/Hind/Bachir). No national eID infra; verification depends on document capture + biometric liveness.
kycAml_morocco.fatf: Removed from FATF grey list Feb 2023 — enforcement has increased materially.

competitorMarketSignals_CurrencycloudWis.note: CurrencyCloud (Visa) is the cross-border infra leader (36 currencies, 180+ countries, JP Morgan as principal bank). Wise operates a different settlement model. For our corridor, CurrencyCloud's SWIFT/local + People-API KYC is the most direct fit over PayPal (blocked) and Payoneer (no creds).

immediate.action: Turn OFF the outbound auto-runner (AUTONOMOUS_AUTO_SUBMIT_PAYPAL_PAYOUT_BATCHES) until rails are real. It is the source of the synthetic reprocessing loop.
Stop generating synthetic sequential transaction refs. Require provider-issued rail IDs (MT103, bank_txn) before any PayoutItem/batch can be marked deliveryConfirmed.
Purge/archive the 604 failed + retry-spawned synthetic batches on Base44 so drift aggregates reflect reality; keep an immutable audit trail of the archived rows.
Re-verify the 27 needs_manual_proof OwnerSettlements ($13,744.11) and the 3 revenue rows lacking proofHash before progressing any payout.

strategic.action: Evaluate CurrencyCloud (Visa Cross-Border) as the primary outbound rail for Younes → Attijariwafa (RIB 372) and Banking Circle USD; satisfies strict proofHash/externalRef via real rail txn IDs.

Scope a BAM-compliant eKYC flow (Law 43-05/12-18): CIN + liveness for the 3 beneficiaries, UBO 25%+ documentation, SDD/EDD risk classification — required for both currency-cloud onboarding and any PI-licence ambitions.
Model the crypto ban: as-is, CRYPTO_WITHDRAW_ENABLE conflicts with Morocco's blanket prohibition. Get legal counsel before activating any crypto settlement to the corridor.
Implement 10-year record retention + ANRF MAD 200k cash-reporting hooks in the audit ledger to stay ahead of Law 43-05 / 12-18.
Track the GSIMT instant rail + e-Dirham CBDC + open-banking roadmap; the MAD 20k cap and ISO 20022 shape a future real-time settlement posture.
